title: Smooth panel resizing animation when content size changes
line: Panels set to fit their content now grow and shrink smoothly when a task or widget is added or removed, instead of jumping to the new size.
explanation: A fit-content panel's length is bound straight to its containment's preferred width (height for vertical panels), so when a task button or widget appears or disappears the panel window is resized to the new length in a single frame. The change moves that value into a property with a Behavior that animates it (Kirigami longDuration, OutCubic) only while the panel's length mode is Fit content; fill and custom panels are unchanged, and the global animation speed setting still applies.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: animate size changes of panels that fit their content

When a panel set to fit its content got a new task or widget, it jumped
to its new size in a single frame. Now its length is animated with the
usual duration, so it grows and shrinks smoothly; other modes don't change.

BUG: 506137
